stem_md: 设 $z=e^u\sin v$，$u=xy$，$v=x+y$，下面关于 $z_x,z_y$ 的计算正确的是哪一组？
analysis_md:
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\cdot\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=e^u\sin v\cdot y+e^u\cos v\cdot1$

$=e^u(y\sin v+\cos v)=e^{xy}\left[y\sin(x+y)+\cos(x+y)\right]$

$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\cdot\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\cdot\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=e^u\sin v\cdot x+e^u\cos v\cdot1$

$=e^u(x\sin v+\cos v)=e^{xy}\left[x\sin(x+y)+\cos(x+y)\right]$
